title: GMAT Focus Data Insights Practice Test 28
instructions: Original exam-style practice test with answers and explanations.

questions.prompt: A graph showing visitor spending by activity in the tourism sector presents the following data: Accommodation: 38%, Food: 24%, Transport: 18%, Entertainment: 12%, Shopping: 8%. According to the graph, which segment/period shows the highest value?
options: D. The value closest to the overall average
E. Cannot be determined from the data
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret tourism data on visitor spending by activity.

questions.prompt: Based on the chart of time-to-hire by department data (Engineering: 47 days, Marketing: 31 days, Finance: 28 days, Sales: 22 days, HR: 19 days), which TWO values would combine to equal approximately the average?
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret recruitment data on time-to-hire by department.

dataContext.data: Engineering: 47 days, Marketing: 31 days, Finance: 28 days, Sales: 22 days, HR: 19 days

questions.prompt: A scatter plot comparing emissions reduction by sector across environmental categories shows: Energy: -14%, Transport: -8%, Industry: -6%, Agriculture: -3%, Buildings: -11%. If the trend continued, which projection is most consistent?
options: D. The value closest to the overall average
E. Cannot be determined from the data
questions.explanation: This graphics_interpretation question tests ability to interpret environmental data on emissions reduction by sector.

questions.prompt: Analysis of content viewing patterns in streaming media: Drama: 35%, Comedy: 22%, Documentary: 18%, Action: 15%, Other: 10%. Select the value closest to the median AND the value that represents the greatest deviation from the mean.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret streaming media data on content viewing patterns.

questions.prompt: Given supply chain supplier performance scores data: Quality: 87/100, Delivery: 79/100, Price: 83/100, Responsiveness: 91/100, Sustainability: 74/100. In the left column select the highest-performing category; in the right column select the category that improved most year-over-year.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret supply chain data on supplier performance scores.

questions.prompt: A fitness manager reviews gym membership usage: Peak hours 6-8am: 42%, 12-2pm: 18%, 5-8pm: 56%, 8-10pm: 23%, Other: 12%. Select: (1) the category requiring immediate attention and (2) the category that exceeds the target of the average by the greatest margin.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret fitness data on gym membership usage.

questions.prompt: Analysis of incident response times in cybersecurity: Detection: 4.2h, Containment: 2.8h, Eradication: 6.1h, Recovery: 12.4h, Documentation: 3.9h. Select the value closest to the median AND the value that represents the greatest deviation from the mean.
questions.explanation: This two_part_analysis question tests ability to interpret cybersecurity data on incident response times.

questions.prompt: Three data sources on property management occupancy rates by building type are provided: (Memo) Overall performance improved this quarter. (Table) Office A-grade: 94%, Office B-grade: 78%, Retail flagship: 97%, Retail secondary: 81%, Industrial: 89%. (Email) Stakeholders express concern about outliers. Which source most directly supports the memo's claim?
options: E. All three sources are equally relevant
questions.explanation: This multi_source_reasoning question tests ability to interpret property management data on occupancy rates by building type.

dataContext.data: Office A-grade: 94%, Office B-grade: 78%, Retail flagship: 97%, Retail secondary: 81%, Industrial: 89%

questions.prompt: Source 1 (Report): retail sales quarterly revenue shows: Q1: $2.4M, Q2: $3.1M, Q3: $2.8M, Q4: $3.6M. Source 2 (Email): The weakest performer needs a 20% improvement to meet targets. Source 3 (Table): Targets are set at the top-quartile value. Which category needs improvement?
options: E. All three sources are equally relevant

questions.prompt: Reviewing hospital operations records: Source A shows patient wait times: Emergency: 45min, Outpatient: 28min, Radiology: 62min, Laboratory: 19min. Source B notes the average. Source C flags values more than 25% above or below average. Which values would Source C flag?
options: E. All three sources are equally relevant

questions.prompt: What is the relative ranking of categories in logistics delivery performance? (1) On-time: 78%. (2) The remaining values follow a consistent trend.

C. Both statements together are sufficient, but neither alone is sufficient
D. Each statement alone is sufficient
E. Neither statement alone nor together is sufficient
